# economics

> Garden tag: economics

## Garden

- [Taxonomizing Price Shocks](https://blog.cani.ne.jp/garden/taxonomizing-price-shocks.md): A field guide to shortages and price spikes, sorted by who actually holds the choke point: the supplier, the regulator, or the customer next to you.
- [A General-Purpose Industry-Refining Tool](https://blog.cani.ne.jp/garden/general-purpose-industry-refining-tool.md): Refinement of industries - industrialization - has a rhyming shape every time it crops up.
